request.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Redraw it as another member of the same society in the same blue hood: the hood becomes a very tall straight narrow pointed cone that reaches the top of the image; a pale cream collar lies round the neck; the cream mitten holds up one small polished brass hand bell. No candle. Keep the blue cloth, the black hood opening with its two cream eyes, the size, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
